Definition: from G906; a missile, i.e. spear or arrow:--dart.
BiblicalUsage: belos carries the plain sense of a dart, a missile, and it shows up only once, in Ephesians 6:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that belos is a small window into a bigger truth, and I am glad it is there.
